actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.description: Custom action in ZoneBilling for NetSuite (Custom)
actions.help: Build your own ZoneBilling action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your ZoneBilling NetSuite connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

input.name: record_type
input.label: Record Type
input.hint: Select the target record type in NetSuite

input.name: record_type
input.label: Record Type
input.hint: Select the target record type in NetSuite

actions.name: get_file
actions.title: Get File
actions.description: Get a File from the File Cabinet in NetSuite

input.name: record_id
input.label: File ID
input.hint: Specify the specific file ID you would like to retrieve from the File Cabinet

actions.name: get_process_status
actions.title: Get Bulk API Status
actions.description: Get the status for a ZAB Process in NetSuite

input.name: process_id
input.label: Process ID
input.hint: Indicate the Process ID you would like to gather details on.

actions.name: get_record
actions.title: Get Record
actions.description: Get Record from a ZAB API Export in NetSuite

input.name: export_id
input.label: ZAB API Export
input.hint: Select a pre-configured ZAB API Export record that corresponds to a saved search of records within your NetSuite account.

input.name: internal_id
input.label: Identifier
input.hint: Specify a specific record internal id you would like to retrieve

properties.name: include_empty_properties
properties.label: Include Empty Properties
properties.hint: If true, properties/fields that have empty values will be included in the results

properties.name: text_always
properties.label: Include Text Always
properties.hint: If true, a text property will be returned for each attribute, even if it is the same as the value

properties.name: label_as_key
properties.label: Use NetSuite Column Label as Result Key
properties.hint: If true, the object keys will be the NetSuite Search Column Labels

input.name: record_type
input.label: Record Type
input.hint: Select the record type you are looking to export.

input.name: record_id
input.label: Record ID
input.hint: Specify the specific record internal ID you would like to retrieve
